**Download Polish right in the app.** No Terminal needed for the optional Polish model any more. No license changes; no breaking changes (a Polish model you converted yourself keeps working).

## Polish download

- The menu shows **Polish · Download (1.19 GB)…** until the model is installed. Clicking it downloads the original [spokenly/cleanup-1](https://huggingface.co/spokenly/cleanup-1) (Apache-2.0) from Hugging Face, checks it against fixed checksums, converts it to a 4-bit MLX model on your Mac in a second or two, and turns Polish on. While it downloads, the menu shows the progress and a **Cancel** item; a cancelled download resumes where it stopped.
- The converted model is identical to the one made with `mlx_lm.convert -q --q-bits 4` (the command in the README still works as an alternative).
- The Polish download is available once a speech model is installed, so the first-run setup always starts with the speech model.
- As with the speech models, this download only happens when you click it; recognition and Polish run entirely on your Mac.

## Command line

- `tsuzuri-cli --download --polish` downloads and converts the Polish model the same way.

## Docs

- README (English, Japanese, Chinese): the Polish section now uses the menu download; the Terminal conversion is kept as an alternative. The FAQ explains how pasting works in Chrome and on the desktop / in Finder.
